### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

## Creating

## packaging solutions

## for life's essentials.

Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best
performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums,
intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated
recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty
products. 

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a
wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States.
Greif is strategically positioned in more than 40 countries to serve customers of all sizes and
needs.

Greif 2030 Sustainability Targets

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

## GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31,
2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and
fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

## **Greif Barrier Technology**

We design and manufacture containers that do more than hold products, they actively protect what
matters most. Greif’s expertise in barrier science and technology helps keep your product exactly
where it belongs: inside the package, not absorbed into the container walls or released into the
surrounding environment.
* Reduces Emissions And Leakage Risks
* Maintains Product Purity During Storage And Transport
* Protects Against Oxygen, Moisture And Chemical Exposure

## 2030 SUSTAINABILITY TARGETS

These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement in 2021 to
reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

The broader sustainability focus for the company continues to be advancing a circular economy,
reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and championing diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives.

[Learn More][126]
Target One: Waste

## 97%

**Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities**

By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets
97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills by 2030.

[Learn More][127]
Target Two: Circularity

## 100%

**Make 100% of its Products Recyclable** 

Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be
benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][128]
Target Three: CIRCULARITY

## 60%

**Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products**

Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of
materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

[Learn More][129]
Target Four: DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

## =

**Attain Global Gender Pay Parity**

Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work by 2024 and is committed to
maintaining gender pay parity.

[Learn More][130]
Target Five: Suppliers

## 80%

**Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers**

By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can
have a greater impact across its value chain.

[Learn More][131]

## GREIF LAUNCHES 2023 SUSTAINABILITY REPORT

Greif’s 2023 Sustainability Report covers our fiscal year from November 1, 2022, through October 31,
2023. This report is prepared in accordance with the GRI Standards and SASB Application Guidance and
fulfills the United Nations Global Compact’s (UNGC) annual Communication on Progress (COP).

We design and manufacture containers that do more than hold products, they actively protect what

surrounding environment.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

# AboutUs

The independent trust record for every website — the page you check before you trust, buy from, or
link to a site you don't know. Sourced, dated facts. Not verdicts.

Search

Can I trust this site?

## Every record answers with sourced, dated facts.

Current facts

Verified from the live website and public infrastructure — authority, safety, and identity signals,
each with its source and date.

Historical record

What this website said about itself over the years — dated evidence from a record kept since 2006,
never edited after the fact.

Profiles

## Featured website profiles

[

From the current website

### sitsorted.com

Free Pet & House Sitter Instructions | SitSorted

SitSorted provides free tools to create and share clear pet and house sitter instructions with
someone you've already chosen to care for your home or pets. It helps homeowners and pet owners
organize feeding schedules, routines, emergency contacts, and care details into a single printable
or shareable brief, without requiring sitter sign-up or account creation. All drafts remain private
on your device unless explicitly shared.

][9]
Authority — · Safety —[View report][10]
[

From the current website

### consulics.com

File Form 2290 (HVUT), Stamped Schedule 1 in Minutes | Consulics

Consulics is an IRS-authorized e-file provider specializing in Form 2290 (Heavy Vehicle Use Tax)
filing and Form 8849 refund claims for owner-operators, trucking fleets, and tax professionals. The
service delivers IRS-stamped Schedule 1 documents within minutes and offers free VIN corrections and
broader trucking-compliance tools. Consulics is listed on the IRS 2026 Form 2290 MeF Provider List
and serves all 50 states.

][11]
Authority — · Safety —[View report][12]
[

From the current website

### ukholidaysinfo.uk

UK Bank Holidays 2026 — England, Scotland, Wales and NI

ukholidaysinfo.uk provides confirmed UK bank holiday dates and calendars for 2026 and beyond, broken
down by region (England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland). The site serves UK residents and
employees planning annual leave, offering long-weekend planners, employment rights guidance, and
regional differences. All dates are verified against the official gov.uk bank holidays page.

][13]
Authority — · Safety —[View report][14]
[

From the current website

### exity.com.au

Business for Sale Australia | Buy & Sell | Exity

Exity is Australia's online marketplace for buying and selling businesses, connecting private buyers
and sellers directly. The platform lists businesses across hospitality, retail, services,
manufacturing, healthcare, and other sectors, with tools for valuation, verified listings, and
filtered search.

][15]
Authority — · Safety —[View report][16]
[

From the current website

### techontoday.com

Tech On Today - Future Tech, AI News & Smart Gadget Reviews

Tech On Today publishes news, reviews, and buying guides focused on artificial intelligence,
emerging technology trends, smart gadgets, and hardware. The site serves readers interested in AI
tools, consumer tech, and productivity software. Content includes comparisons of AI assistants,
reviews of laptops and smart home devices, and analysis of industry developments like semiconductor
advances.

][17]
Authority — · Safety —[View report][18]
[

From the current website

### proveguru.com

ProveGuru.com - Free Online Learning & Quiz Platform

ProveGuru is a free online platform offering quizzes and learning content for students, with a focus
on school curricula including CBSE and NCERT materials. It provides multiple-choice quizzes across
subjects like math, English grammar, science, and general knowledge for classes 1–8, as well as
geography and animal knowledge quizzes for general audiences.

][19]

### Private Enterprises

Supporting private enterprises, large and small, manufacturing facilities and distribution

complexes globally.

### Energy Sector

infrastructure projects.

International Presence

We understand the importance of reliability in the world of manufacturing. The trust you place in us
is something we honor with unwavering commitment. Our streamlined production processes, rigorous
quality control, and dedication to meeting deadlines ensure that you can count on us as a reliable

**Endless Applications**

Plastics are everywhere, and so are we. Our products find their way into a wide range of industries,
from automotive and aerospace to medical devices and consumer goods. The versatility of plastic
allows us to craft solutions for virtually any application, and our expertise spans across multiple
industries. No matter your sector, we have the tools and knowledge to meet your unique needs.

**Environmentally Responsible**

Sustainability is not just a buzzword for us; it’s a commitment. We are proud to embrace
eco-friendly practices in our manufacturing processes. From efficient resource utilization to
reducing waste and energy consumption, we are dedicated to minimizing our environmental footprint.
AdvanTech Plastics is your partner for sustainable, responsible manufacturing.

We invite you to explore our website and discover how AdvanTech Plastics can take your projects to
the next level. Join the ranks of countless satisfied clients who have made us their first choice
for plastic injection molding. When it comes to plastics precision, innovation, quality, and
sustainability, choose AdvanTech Plastics—where your vision becomes reality.

1. What industries does AdvanTech Plastics serve?

We support a wide range of industries including medical devices, food & beverage packaging,
industrial components, consumer products, and automotive assemblies. Our clean-room capabilities and
ISO-certified processes allow us to meet exacting requirements for highly regulated markets.

—

2. Does AdvanTech handle both prototype and high-volume production?

Yes. We provide rapid prototypes, short runs, pilot production, and fully-automated high-volume
molding using 96-cavity tooling, robotics, and advanced process monitoring.

—

3. What materials can AdvanTech mold?

We work with nearly all engineering-grade and commodity resins, including PP, PE, ABS, PC, PS, TPE,
TPU, PEEK, POM, nylon, and medical-grade polymers. If needed, we help customers select the right
resin for strength, clarity, chemical resistance, and regulatory compliance.

—

4. Does AdvanTech offer clean-room molding for medical devices?

Yes. We operate ISO Class 7 and Class 8 clean-room environments for molding, assembly, and packaging
of medical components. Our quality system meets ISO 13485 standards, and we can support validation,
traceability, and FDA compliance requirements.

—

5. What secondary services and value-added operations do you provide?

We offer ultrasonic welding, pad printing, assembly, post-molding finishing, in-mold labeling,
robotic handling, and packaging services. This allows you to consolidate vendors and streamline
production.

—

6. Can AdvanTech assist with product design or mold design?

Yes. Our engineering team provides DFM analysis, mold-flow simulations, and design recommendations
to reduce cycle times, minimize defects, and optimize manufacturability. We collaborate closely with
customers from concept through production.

—

7. Do you manufacture molds in-house?

We partner with highly reliable domestic and international mold makers and manage the entire tooling
process. We can also handle tool transfers, mold repairs, and maintenance for existing tooling.

—

8. What are your typical production lead times?

Lead times vary by complexity and volume, but most projects move from kickoff to production in 6–12
weeks, with repeat orders often shipping in days, thanks to our automated cells and lean processes.

—

9. How does AdvanTech ensure quality and consistency?

We use scientific molding, in-process monitoring, automated inspection, and robust ISO 9001 and ISO
13485 quality systems. Every job includes documented workflows, lot traceability, and continuous
process verification.

—

10. Can you handle large or complex projects with multiple components?

Yes. We routinely manage complex assemblies, multi-component systems, over-molding, insert molding,
and projects requiring tight tolerances or specialized resins. Our facility is designed to support
both small and large program launches.

—

11. Where is AdvanTech Plastics located?

We are headquartered in Woodstock, Illinois, serving customers throughout the Chicago region, the
Midwest, and nationwide. We offer reliable domestic manufacturing for companies looking to reduce
risk and shorten supply chains.

—

12. How do I request a quote or start a project with AdvanTech?

You can request a quote directly through our website’s [Contact/Quote form][55] or by calling our
team. We typically respond within one business day to gather details, review drawings, and provide
next steps.

Precision and quality is our guiding star, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Our
cutting-edge injection molding technology, combined with a team of highly skilled professionals,
ensures that every part we produce is built to the tightest tolerances, meeting and often exceeding
the most demanding industry standards. We understand that your success hinges on the quality and
precision of our work, and we are obsessed with meeting your needs.

**Innovation at the Heart**

Innovation fuels progress, and at AdvanTech Plastics, we embrace it wholeheartedly. We work closely
with our partners to turn ideas into reality, from concept to creation. Our engineers are not just
experts in their field; they’re passionate problem solvers, constantly seeking new and more
efficient ways to bring your designs to life. We’re not content with merely keeping pace with
industry trends; we set the pace, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in plastic injection
molding.

**Your Reliable Partner**

We understand the importance of reliability in the world of manufacturing. The trust you place in us
is something we honor with unwavering commitment. Our streamlined production processes, rigorous
quality control, and dedication to meeting deadlines ensure that you can count on us as a reliable
partner. When you choose AdvanTech Plastics, you’re choosing a team that stands with you through
every step of your project, from initial concept to final delivery.

**Endless Applications**

Plastics are everywhere, and so are we. Our products find their way into a wide range of industries,
from automotive and aerospace to medical devices and consumer goods. The versatility of plastic
allows us to craft solutions for virtually any application, and our expertise spans across multiple
industries. No matter your sector, we have the tools and knowledge to meet your unique needs.

**Environmentally Responsible**

Sustainability is not just a buzzword for us; it’s a commitment. We are proud to embrace
eco-friendly practices in our manufacturing processes. From efficient resource utilization to
reducing waste and energy consumption, we are dedicated to minimizing our environmental footprint.
AdvanTech Plastics is your partner for sustainable, responsible manufacturing.

We invite you to explore our website and discover how AdvanTech Plastics can take your projects to
the next level. Join the ranks of countless satisfied clients who have made us their first choice
for plastic injection molding. When it comes to plastics precision, innovation, quality, and
sustainability, choose AdvanTech Plastics—where your vision becomes reality.

1. What industries does AdvanTech Plastics serve?

We support a wide range of industries including medical devices, food & beverage packaging,
industrial components, consumer products, and automotive assemblies. Our clean-room capabilities and
ISO-certified processes allow us to meet exacting requirements for highly regulated markets.

—

2. Does AdvanTech handle both prototype and high-volume production?

Yes. We provide rapid prototypes, short runs, pilot production, and fully-automated high-volume
molding using 96-cavity tooling, robotics, and advanced process monitoring.

—

3. What materials can AdvanTech mold?

We work with nearly all engineering-grade and commodity resins, including PP, PE, ABS, PC, PS, TPE,
TPU, PEEK, POM, nylon, and medical-grade polymers. If needed, we help customers select the right
resin for strength, clarity, chemical resistance, and regulatory compliance.

—

4. Does AdvanTech offer clean-room molding for medical devices?

Yes. We operate ISO Class 7 and Class 8 clean-room environments for molding, assembly, and packaging
of medical components. Our quality system meets ISO 13485 standards, and we can support validation,
traceability, and FDA compliance requirements.

—

5. What secondary services and value-added operations do you provide?

We offer ultrasonic welding, pad printing, assembly, post-molding finishing, in-mold labeling,
robotic handling, and packaging services. This allows you to consolidate vendors and streamline
production.

—

6. Can AdvanTech assist with product design or mold design?

Yes. Our engineering team provides DFM analysis, mold-flow simulations, and design recommendations
to reduce cycle times, minimize defects, and optimize manufacturability. We collaborate closely with
customers from concept through production.

—

7. Do you manufacture molds in-house?

We partner with highly reliable domestic and international mold makers and manage the entire tooling
process. We can also handle tool transfers, mold repairs, and maintenance for existing tooling.

—

8. What are your typical production lead times?

Lead times vary by complexity and volume, but most projects move from kickoff to production in 6–12
weeks, with repeat orders often shipping in days, thanks to our automated cells and lean processes.

—

9. How does AdvanTech ensure quality and consistency?

We use scientific molding, in-process monitoring, automated inspection, and robust ISO 9001 and ISO
13485 quality systems. Every job includes documented workflows, lot traceability, and continuous
process verification.

—

10. Can you handle large or complex projects with multiple components?

Yes. We routinely manage complex assemblies, multi-component systems, over-molding, insert molding,
and projects requiring tight tolerances or specialized resins. Our facility is designed to support
both small and large program launches.

—

11. Where is AdvanTech Plastics located?

We are headquartered in Woodstock, Illinois, serving customers throughout the Chicago region, the
Midwest, and nationwide. We offer reliable domestic manufacturing for companies looking to reduce
risk and shorten supply chains.

—

12. How do I request a quote or start a project with AdvanTech?

You can request a quote directly through our website’s [Contact/Quote form][55] or by calling our
team. We typically respond within one business day to gather details, review drawings, and provide
next steps.

# The road to innovation

CCC is a leading vertical market software platform, harnessing deep industry expertise, data, and

[ Buyout ][57] [ technology ][58]

combination of our resources and thought partnership."

Managing Director, Advent

# Working hand-in-hand with management

Advent partnered with a visionary management team to continue to build out a best-in-class suite of
software solutions for insurance carriers, collision repair shops, and automotive manufacturers.

# Going the extra mile

In partnership with management, Advent prioritized strengthening the CCC network of customers and
invested in a variety of new product initiatives to create a truly end-to-end software platform.

[ Buyout ][59] [ technology ][60]
[ Read full story ][61]

# A green revolution in last mile parcel delivery

In 2015, serial entrepreneur and ex-parcel delivery driver, Rafał Brzoska, was seeking funding for
the innovative parcel delivery company he’d built from scratch. He realized that it was better for
the environment and more convenient for consumers if trucks delivered hundreds of parcels to one
location, where consumers could pick them up from hi-tech lockers at their leisure.

[ Buyout ][62] [ Technology ][63]
[Rafał Brzoska]

“Advent trusted me to make the right calls. Some funds stifle their management, but Advent gave me
the tools and let me get on with the job of executing the plan. It was an intensive partnership with
some robust discussions, but it was a true partnership and I couldn’t have got to where I am so
quickly without them.”

Rafał Brzoska

CEO, InPost

[Ranjan Sen]

“We believed that with the right focus and resources, InPost, under the leadership of an exceptional
entrepreneur like Rafał, had the potential to disrupt not only Poland but also across Europe in an
industry ripe for innovation.”

Ranjan Sen

Managing Partner, Advent and InPost board member

# Going back to its roots

Rapid expansion had taken a financial toll on the company, and the existing locker network was
spread too thinly. Working alongside Brzoska, we hatched a plan to refocus on its two strongest
markets: Poland and the UK. We then invested heavily to put the consumer at the center of an
expanded locker network.

# Unlocking further growth

Together with Advent’s Portfolio Support Group, an enhanced management team set about driving
operational change, improving depot efficiency by 80% within six months. Then, when Covid-19 hit,
the team quickly advertised the safety virtues of InPost’s system. It partnered with retailers to
get goods to consumers quickly and safely during the pandemic, leading consumers to flock to the
business.

# Transforming the logistics sub-sector

When we acquired InPost in 2017, it was heavily financially stressed. After taking the company
private, we worked with management to reorient the business. During Advent’s ownership, InPost
increased growth in parcel and locker volume 8x and ~6x, respectively, from 2016 to 2020.

[ Buyout ][64] [ Technology ][65]
[ Read full story ][66]

# Breathing new life into Bharat Serums and Vaccines

At Bharat Serums and Vaccines (BSV), Advent identified a company with the potential to become a
domestic and international provider of health and fertility products for millions of women.

[ buyout ][67] [ healthcare ][68]
[Pankaj Patwari]

BSV is a true case of business building. Advent executed our value creation plan, and it’s very
satisfying that a large strategic buyer has now acquired the company because it can see its growth
potential.

Pankaj Patwari

Managing Director, Advent

[Sanjiv Navangul]

In partnership with Advent, we created one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India, with a
culture of innovation and an exciting pipeline of products with global appeal.

Sanjiv Navangul

Managing Director and CEO, BSV

# Planning a path to recovery

Advent developed a plan to realize the full potential of BSV based on four key themes: build a new
management and governance structure; commercialize the product pipeline; pursue international
expansion; and revamp the domestic go-to-market strategy.

# Breathing new life into BSV

Advent provided extensive support to the management team, overhauled the operations and pricing
strategy, and refocused research and development on building a best-in-class pipeline across BSV’s
three core therapy areas throughout five key markets.

# A company reborn

When Advent sold the business, it had been transformed into a champion in women’s health. Just as
importantly, we invested heavily to build a better line of treatments to benefit millions of women
in India and internationally. Today, BSV remains committed to widening access and availability of
innovative treatments for women while delivering positive patient outcomes.

[ buyout ][69] [ healthcare ][70]
[ Read full story ][71]

# Making investing simpler with Easynvest

During our partnership with Easynvest, now known as NuInvest, we identified an opportunity to evolve
a traditional stockbroker to a fintech business focused on making investing simpler for Brazilians.

[ Buyout ][72] [ Business & financial services ][73]
[Fernando Miranda]

“With the support of Advent, we created and introduced a new platform for fee-free equity trading
that emphasized simplicity.”

Fernando Miranda

Former CEO, Easynvest

[Brenno Raiko]

“Easynvest could have created offline services, but it wanted to stay true to its digital roots.
This approach paid off as we quadrupled the number of users during our partnership with the
company.”

Brenno Raiko

Managing Director, Advent

# Out with the old, in with the new

Advent invested in Easynvest in 2018 and seized an opportunity to change the way Brazilians think
about investing by supporting a user-friendly open loop investment platform. Our prior experience in
the business & financial services sector enabled us to support Easynvest’s strategy and implement
governance structures to support its next phase of evolution.

# The digital revolution

Throughout our partnership, Easynvest was equipped with the resources to further invest in its
digital platform. These efforts included developing an online marketplace to allow customers to
invest in a range of financial instruments and enhancing the company’s online platform to provide a
seamless user experience.

# Investing in the future

A competitive exit process involved strategic players and financial sponsors that were drawn to
Easynvest due to its functionality and ability to simplify investing. Recognizing that scale was
crucial for ongoing success, Advent determined that a strategic sale was the best next step for
Easynvest to continue expanding its customer base.

Looking for an opportunity to expand into the Brazilian groceries sector, in 2018 Advent signed a

# A green revolution in last mile parcel delivery

In 2015, serial entrepreneur and ex-parcel delivery driver, Rafał Brzoska, was seeking funding for
the innovative parcel delivery company he’d built from scratch. He realized that it was better for
the environment and more convenient for consumers if trucks delivered hundreds of parcels to one
location, where consumers could pick them up from hi-tech lockers at their leisure.

[ Buyout ][62] [ Technology ][63]
[Rafał Brzoska]

“Advent trusted me to make the right calls. Some funds stifle their management, but Advent gave me
the tools and let me get on with the job of executing the plan. It was an intensive partnership with
some robust discussions, but it was a true partnership and I couldn’t have got to where I am so
quickly without them.”

Rafał Brzoska

[Ranjan Sen]

“We believed that with the right focus and resources, InPost, under the leadership of an exceptional
entrepreneur like Rafał, had the potential to disrupt not only Poland but also across Europe in an
industry ripe for innovation.”

Ranjan Sen

Managing Partner, Advent and InPost board member

# Going back to its roots

Rapid expansion had taken a financial toll on the company, and the existing locker network was
spread too thinly. Working alongside Brzoska, we hatched a plan to refocus on its two strongest
markets: Poland and the UK. We then invested heavily to put the consumer at the center of an
expanded locker network.

# Unlocking further growth

Together with Advent’s Portfolio Support Group, an enhanced management team set about driving
operational change, improving depot efficiency by 80% within six months. Then, when Covid-19 hit,
the team quickly advertised the safety virtues of InPost’s system. It partnered with retailers to
get goods to consumers quickly and safely during the pandemic, leading consumers to flock to the
business.

# Transforming the logistics sub-sector

When we acquired InPost in 2017, it was heavily financially stressed. After taking the company
private, we worked with management to reorient the business. During Advent’s ownership, InPost
increased growth in parcel and locker volume 8x and ~6x, respectively, from 2016 to 2020.

Featured Product

[Freezer spacers product image]

#### Plastic Freezer Spacers

Cut blast freezing time by up to 25% with Altium’s USA-made Standard and Maxi designs.
FDA-compliant, 100% recyclable, and trusted by food processors across meat, poultry, and cold
storage applications.

[Request a Quote][163]

## Your Market. Our Solutions.

We are committed to bringing our customers big design ideas and manufacturing excellence rooted in
creative innovation and branding know-how.

[Request a quote][164]
[

## Dairy

][165]

Whether you call them jugs, bottles, rounds, or containers, Altium Packaging is a leading producer
of standard and lightweight rigid plastic dairy bottles.

[

## Water

][166]

It’s clear to see that reliable containers are essential for efficiently transporting drinking water
and making brands stand out.

[

## Beverage

][167]

Consumer beverage preferences are constantly changing. We can provide packaging solutions that keep
you ahead of the curve.

[

## Food

][168]

People eat with their eyes first. The right packaging can make your product look as appetizing as it
tastes.

[

## Nutrition

][169]

From single-serve to bulk sizes, Altium Packaging has cutting-edge packaging to meet demands and
distinguish brands in the growing nutrition industry.

[

## Household Chemicals

][170]

Whether your product helps keep kitchen counters free from dangerous bacteria or windows sparkling,
our innovative rigid plastic packaging has got you covered.

[

## Specialty Chemicals

][171]

Greener grass or shinier surfaces, we design robust packaging with your product in mind.

[

## Automotive

][172]

If your product helps a car go, turn, or stop, chances are good we have the packaging solution.

[

## Personal Care

][173]

Altium Packaging creates packaging that cares for your product as much as your product cares for
consumers.

[

## Healthcare

][174]

Altium Healthcare’s complete line of containers and closures for prescription, over-the-counter, and
wellness products also feature safety protection for children and senior adults.

[

## Design Center

][175]
[

## Case Studies

][176]
[

## Product Catalog

][177]

## Our Network In The U.S. And Canada

At Altium Packaging, we are committed to ensuring our customers receive personalized service with
the dependability, flexibility and creativity our unique organization is known for. We achieve this
through our network of 65+ plants in the U.S. and Canada, 100 years of innovation, high quality
customer service, and nearly 4,000 dedicated employees.

## Forward Thinking

We design packaging solutions for beverage and consumer industrial products. It’s our job to help
your brand stand out and your business grow—and we take that responsibility seriously. The success
of your products and the future of your organization drive us to excel in our effort to be among the
leading plastic containers packaging suppliers in the world. Strong partnerships with those we serve
are what matters most to the Altium Packaging team.

[

## Why Altium

][178]

The leading customer-centric packaging solutions provider that helps elevate your brand.

[Learn More][179]
[

## Sustainability

][180]

Our sustainable solutions and practices drive value to our customers and protect the environment

[Learn More][181]
[

## What You Get When You Partner With Us

][182]

From the talented designers of Studio PKG™, to our experienced manufacturing teams across the
network, to our focus on environmental stewardship, Altium delivers. We pride ourselves on the
partnerships we’ve forged over the past two decades and will continue to deliver for you: High
performance packaging solutions. A cost-effective approach to meeting your needs. And the commitment
to sustainability practices that add even more value to you and your customers.

[Learn More][183]

### Packaging Solutions Always Made Right®

With a diverse stock bottle portfolio and an innovative design team working to produce creative
packaging solutions, we can help you find the perfect solution.

[Contact Us][184]

# High-Quality Packaging Solutions and Customized Services

C.L. Smith (CLS) is a premier, full-service bottle manufacturer, UN Certifier, and full-stocking
distributor of high-quality and cost-effective packaging materials and containers.

[CONTACT US][243]
1975
Year Established
75
Employees
4
Countries
3,486k
Satisfied Customers

## Who We Are

At C.L. Smith, our mission is simple: make your packaging challenges easier and your business
stronger. For 50 years, we’ve built our reputation on exceptional customer care, partnering with
companies like yours to deliver packaging solutions that protect your products, simplify your supply
chain, and help you grow.

As a full-service packaging partner, we offer custom design, manufacturing—including bottle
molding—and single-source purchasing for hazmat containers and everyday packaging needs. Now part of
the Novvia Group, we combine local expertise with a nationwide network, ensuring fast, dependable
service wherever you do business.

Experience how C.L. Smith’s passion for service and commitment to your success can make a difference
for your business.

[Learn More About Us][244]
[Three professionals in a warehouse: a man in a safety vest and helmet holds a plastic jug, while a
woman with a laptop and a man with a clipboard smile and discuss the product among shelves of
containers.]

## What We Do

[[containers]][245]
[[bottle molding]][246]
[[custom designed]][247]
[[hazardous mat]][248]

## Is your company in need of trusted hazardous material packaging?

Our HAZPlus division offers turn-key service to ensure compliance: design, testing, certification
and manufacturing.

[LEARN MORE][249]

## C.L. Smith Company Customer Promise

[number 1 in a circle]

Years of experience working with hundreds of companies like yours has taught us a very valuable
lesson: **We Exist for Our Customers!** Our business is molded to fit yours—not the other way
around. So we make your challenge ours—we fight for the right solution, no matter what it takes. And
what drives us as a company is the desire to do everything in our power to **MAKE YOUR LIFE
EASIER!**

[number 2 in a circle]

**C.L. Smith** is a company where you can find

**Blow Molding, UN Packaging, Container and Packaging Distribution, and [Custom Designed
Packaging][250]** all under one roof. So, whether you’re looking for packaging, product packaging,
packaging design, manufacturing, or shipping, we are your Partner in Packaging Solutions.

[number 3 in a circle]

We understand that you have a choice – you have a say – and we’re listening! You, our Customer, come
first—your goals are ours, and partnerships are measured in years, not profits.

**WE ARE C.L. SMITH, and we are proudly “ALL IN FOR YOU!”**

[[A brochure cover featuring an arrangement of various plastic bottles and containers above abstract

C.L. Smith (CLS) is a premier, full-service bottle manufacturer, UN Certifier, and full-stocking
distributor of high-quality and cost-effective packaging materials and containers.

## Who We Are

At C.L. Smith, our mission is simple: make your packaging challenges easier and your business
stronger. For 50 years, we’ve built our reputation on exceptional customer care, partnering with
companies like yours to deliver packaging solutions that protect your products, simplify your supply
chain, and help you grow.

As a full-service packaging partner, we offer custom design, manufacturing—including bottle
molding—and single-source purchasing for hazmat containers and everyday packaging needs. Now part of
the Novvia Group, we combine local expertise with a nationwide network, ensuring fast, dependable
service wherever you do business.

Experience how C.L. Smith’s passion for service and commitment to your success can make a difference
for your business.

Package design and tooling developed together

why dordan

Experience behind every packaging program

Dordan brings engineering, tooling, thermoforming, cleanroom manufacturing, and ISO-certified
quality systems together to support packaging programs from design through production.

 

### ISO Class 8 Cleanroom

ISO Class 8 cleanroom manufacturing for regulated medical packaging

### ISO 13485 & ISO 9001 Certified

Certified quality systems supporting consistent manufacturing across medical, industrial, and

Package design, prototyping, and CNC tooling managed under one roof

Domestic manufacturing with direct oversight and responsive customer support

### 4th-Generation Family-Owned & Operated

Family ownership providing long-term stability and accountability

# Glycerine

## ELHUME^{TM} – GLO G3

Glycerine (also known as Glycerin or Propane-1,2,3-triol) is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid
renowned for its exceptional moisturizing and humectant properties. It plays a vital role across
multiple industries — including personal care, pharmaceuticals, food, and chemicals — for its
ability to attract and retain moisture. Trusted refined glycerine suppliers ensure consistent purity
and performance for industrial and cosmetic applications worldwide. Glycerine is a versatile and
widely used ingredient in the chemical industry, known for its ability to retain moisture and
maintain hydration in various formulations. Produced from both plant and animal sources, glycerine
is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid that holds a significant place in the beauty,
pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors. Glycerine Manufacturers focus on producing high-quality, pure
glycerine that meets strict industry standards. The product’s adaptability is a major advantage for
manufacturers involved in custom chemical manufacturing, where consistent performance and purity are
critical.

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for
faster fulfillment.

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for
faster fulfillment.

performance and traceability.

  Polyethylene terephthalate flakes for bottles, containers, and packaging.
* ### HDPE
  
  High-density polyethylene for rigid packaging, pipes, and moulded goods.
* ### PP
  
  Polypropylene in pellets, regrind, or bales for a wide range of industries.
* ### LDPE
  
  Low-density polyethylene for films, liners, and flexible packaging.

At Indepak, we specialize in designing and forming intricate, complex shapes with a high level of
detail while holding tight tolerances.  Our focus on continual innovation and dedication to quality
and service has earned us an exceptional reputation as one of the leading manufacturers of
thermoformed trays, clamshells and blister packaging. We are the precision thermoforming specialists
that will provide a solution for you.

#### Food Packaging

Our success in the food packaging market can be attributed to our commitment to quality and
innovation. From helping clients meet shelf life requirements to designing parts that de-nest
quickly and consistently, we can do it all.

##### Why Indepak?
* FSSC 22000 Certified
* Knowledge of lidding and barrier films
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][67]

#### Medical Packaging

With specially designed processes related to cleaning, PPE, signage and the use of medical grade
materials, Indepak has been a trusted supplier of precision packaging for medical, lab and
pharmaceutical companies for decades.


##### Why Indepak?
* Produce “low particulate parts”
* Operate traceability programs
* Offer silicone coated or internal de-nest material options

[Read More][68]

#### Electronics Packaging

We understand the sensitivity of packaging electronic parts and have worked with leading global
manufacturers to develop the procedures, processes and equipment to ensure success for even the most
challenging applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Work with static dissipative and conductive materials
* Tight tolerance cavities for pick-and-place automation
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][69]

Our experienced design team can collaborate with you to design functional and aesthetically pleasing
packaging that will make your product stand out while also considering aspects such as security,
package fulfillment and sealing methods.

* In-house design and prototyping
* Material specifying and sustainability
* Experience collaborating with other packaging suppliers

[Read More][70]

quality improvement and the need for more sustainable packaging has helped Indepak become a leader
in precision thermoformed trays and totes for industrial applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Ability to design for automation
* Precision thermoforming of intricate shapes
* Innovative “rotate-to-stack” designs

## Specialists in Precision Thermoforming

At Indepak, we specialize in designing and forming intricate, complex shapes with a high level of
detail while holding tight tolerances.  Our focus on continual innovation and dedication to quality
and service has earned us an exceptional reputation as one of the leading manufacturers of
thermoformed trays, clamshells and blister packaging. We are the precision thermoforming specialists
that will provide a solution for you.

#### Food Packaging

Our success in the food packaging market can be attributed to our commitment to quality and
innovation. From helping clients meet shelf life requirements to designing parts that de-nest
quickly and consistently, we can do it all.

##### Why Indepak?
* FSSC 22000 Certified
* Knowledge of lidding and barrier films
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][67]

#### Medical Packaging

With specially designed processes related to cleaning, PPE, signage and the use of medical grade
materials, Indepak has been a trusted supplier of precision packaging for medical, lab and
pharmaceutical companies for decades.


##### Why Indepak?
* Produce “low particulate parts”
* Operate traceability programs
* Offer silicone coated or internal de-nest material options

[Read More][68]

#### Electronics Packaging

We understand the sensitivity of packaging electronic parts and have worked with leading global
manufacturers to develop the procedures, processes and equipment to ensure success for even the most
challenging applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Work with static dissipative and conductive materials
* Tight tolerance cavities for pick-and-place automation
* Experience with automated parts feeding

[Read More][69]

#### Retail Packaging

Our experienced design team can collaborate with you to design functional and aesthetically pleasing
packaging that will make your product stand out while also considering aspects such as security,
package fulfillment and sealing methods.


##### Why Indepak?
* In-house design and prototyping
* Material specifying and sustainability
* Experience collaborating with other packaging suppliers

[Read More][70]

#### Industrial Packaging

The increased adoption of automated pick-and-place robots along with the ongoing focus on continual
quality improvement and the need for more sustainable packaging has helped Indepak become a leader
in precision thermoformed trays and totes for industrial applications.


##### Why Indepak?
* Ability to design for automation
* Precision thermoforming of intricate shapes
* Innovative “rotate-to-stack” designs

[Read More][71]

#### Agricultural Packaging

Located in Portland, Oregon, a center of environmental innovation, Indepak has always exhibited a
great commitment to serving the agricultural market with high-quality, precision parts at
competitive prices.


##### Why Indepak?
* Commitment to the environment
* Precision molding capabilities
* Better performance through better design

[Read More][72]

customer-centric, service-first approach yields timely, accurate and cost-effective solutions from

#### SERVICES

Total Solutions

Indepak delivers innovation, flexibility and assurance as we supply a **Total Solution**. Our
customer-centric, service-first approach yields timely, accurate and cost-effective solutions from
initial design and development through ongoing supply chain management.

##### DESIGN

Indepak has worked closely with our customers to design thousands of innovative packages and
products over the years. We pay attention to space, weight, strength, presentation, cost
containment, etc. so that you end up with the best solution for each application. The precision of
our custom thermoforming team and the end products produced are of the highest level of quality.

**LEARN MORE**

##### PROTOTYPING & TOOLING

We offer a variety of in house options to ensure that the part design will perform to your
expectations. They range from parts formed on soft sample tooling to production quality sample molds
for applications where the design is more finalized and a production quality part is required.
Having a physical prototype part to check fits and test saves valuable time in the development
process.

**LEARN MORE**

##### PRECISION THERMOFORMING

Over the last 5 decades, the Indepak custom thermoforming team’s talent for mechanical engineering
has resulted in a number of pioneering breakthroughs as they developed over 6,000 different products
– many of which people “didn’t think could be done.” Today, as a division of Sinclair & Rush,
Indepak continues to lead in innovation, service and value.

**LEARN MORE**

##### INVENTORY MANAGEMENT

To offer the security of inventory and convenience of quicker shipping response times, Indepak can
partner with you to optimize and manage inventory. We commonly maintain agreed upon inventory levels
both at Indepak and also at our customers’ facilities.

**LEARN MORE**

#### CREATING THE PERFECT SOLUTION

Effective Solutions For Every Need

At Indepak, we’ve been designing custom thermoformed solutions for more than 50 years and can create
just about any type of packaging that you might need.

Solutions

##### Thermoformed Trays

We are experts in producing high-volume, precision-formed trays that need to work in an automated
packaging process, but can manufacture virtually any thermoformed tray.
* Food Grade, FSSC 22000 Certified Trays
* ESD Trays for Electronics
* Lidded Trays (for both plastic and barrier film application)
* Material Handling Trays (for pick-and-place automation)

LEARN MORE

##### Clamshell Packaging

With a focus on precision thermoforming, Indepak has had success in developing all kinds innovative
clamshell packaging including:
* Precision Clamshell Trays
* Tri-fold Clamshells
* Clamshell Containers
* Mock Clamshells

LEARN MORE

##### Blister Packaging

With so much success in developing high-quality, aesthetically pleasing packaging supplied on time,
Indepak manufactures all types of blister packaging:
* Trap Blisters
* Face Seal Blisters
* Full-Face Blisters
* Slide Blisters

LEARN MORE

##### Thermoformed Products

Thermoforming can often be used to create a better, lower-cost option to other forms of
manufacturing and Indepak has manufactured a number of solutions including:
* Thermoformed Products
* Protective Shields
* Product Components

LEARN MORE

#### CREATING THE PERFECT PACKAGING SOLUTION

Manufacturing Locations Worldwide

Indepak, a full-service thermoformed products and packaging manufacturer, is part of the Sinclair &
Rush global family of companies – serving customers from four continents to supply virtually every
market in the world.

#### Contact Us

Discuss Your Project

At Indepak, we work like an extension of your company. Our goal is to fully understand your
application, market, automation equipment and any other needs so that we can recommend the best
material, design and equipment to manufacture a precision solution to satisfy your needs.

how to injection mould plastic and produce kinds of products
2025-08-23
Injection molding is a widely used manufacturing process for producing plastic parts in large
volumes.   Here’s a step-by-step guide to the process, including key critical steps: 1. Design and
Material Selection Product Design: Start with a 3D design of the part (using CAD software like Solid
Works or Auto，CAD). Plastic Material Choice: Select a polymer based on the part’s requirements
(strength, temperature resistance, flexibility, cost, etc.). Common options include: Thermoplastics
(most common): PP, PE, ABS, PC, PET. 2. Mold Design and Fabrication The mold is the core of the
process, typically made of hardened steel (for high-volume production) Key mold features: Cavities:
The hollow shape that forms the part (single or multi-cavity for mass production). Gating system:
Channels that deliver molten plastic to the cavity (e.g., sprue, runner, gate). Gates control flow
rate and location (e.g., edge gates, sub-gates). Cooling system: Water channels within the mold to
cool molten plastic quickly and uniformly (critical for cycle time and part quality). Ejection
system: Pins, plates, or sleeves to push the cooled part out of the mold. 3. Preparing the Plastic
Material Drying: Many hygroscopic plastics PC, ABS) absorb moisture from the air, which causes
bubbles or streaks in the final part. Dry them in a dehumidifying dryer at specific temperatures
(e.g., 80–120°C for ABS) for 2–4 hours. Colorants/Additives: Mix in pigments, fillers (glass fiber),
or stabilizers (UV resistance) as needed. Pre-com pounded materials (already colored) simplify this
step. 4. Injection Molding Machine Setup Injection molding machines consist of an injection unit
(melts plastic) and a clamping unit (holds and opens the mold). Setup steps: Mount the mold: Secure
the mold halves to the clamping unit (fixed and moving platens). Align carefully to avoid damage.
Set temperatures: Heat the barrel (injection unit) in zones to match the plastic’s melting point
(e.g., 180–230°C for PP, 230–300°C for ABS). The nozzle (connects to the mold) is also heated.
Clamping force: Adjust the clamping unit to apply enough force to keep the mold closed during
injection (prevents "flash"—plastic leaking between mold halves). Calculated based on part area and
material pressure. 5. The Injection Molding Cycle A single cycle produces one or more parts and
includes 4 main stages: a. Plasticizing (Melting) Granular plastic is fed into the barrel via a
hopper. A rotating screw pushes the plastic forward, heating it via friction and barrel heaters
until it melts into a viscous fluid (melt). The screw retracts slightly to accumulate a measured
volume of melt (shot size) at the front of the barrel. b. Injection The screw moves forward rapidly,
forcing the molten plastic through the nozzle and into the mold’s gating system, filling the cavity.
Key parameters: Injection pressure: Ensures the mold fills completely (varies by material; e.g.,
700–1500 bar). Injection speed: Controls how fast the cavity fills (too slow = cold spots; too fast
= turbulence/air traps). c.Packing & Holding Once the cavity is full, the screw maintains pressure
(holding pressure) to "pack" additional plastic into the mold, compensating for shrinkage as the
plastic cools. Reduces sink marks and ensures dimensional accuracy. d. Cooling The mold’s cooling
system circulates water to remove heat, solidifying the plastic. e. Ejection After cooling, the
clamping unit opens the mold. Ejection pins push the solidified part out of the cavity. The cycle
repeats (typically 10–60seconds, depending on part size, structure,weight, performance and so on).

how to injection mould plastic and produce kinds of products
2025-08-23
Injection molding is a widely used manufacturing process for producing plastic parts in large
volumes.   Here’s a step-by-step guide to the process, including key critical steps: 1. Design and
Material Selection Product Design: Start with a 3D design of the part (using CAD software like Solid
Works or Auto，CAD). Plastic Material Choice: Select a polymer based on the part’s requirements
(strength, temperature resistance, flexibility, cost, etc.). Common options include: Thermoplastics
(most common): PP, PE, ABS, PC, PET. 2. Mold Design and Fabrication The mold is the core of the
process, typically made of hardened steel (for high-volume production) Key mold features: Cavities:
The hollow shape that forms the part (single or multi-cavity for mass production). Gating system:
Channels that deliver molten plastic to the cavity (e.g., sprue, runner, gate). Gates control flow
rate and location (e.g., edge gates, sub-gates). Cooling system: Water channels within the mold to
cool molten plastic quickly and uniformly (critical for cycle time and part quality). Ejection
system: Pins, plates, or sleeves to push the cooled part out of the mold. 3. Preparing the Plastic
Material Drying: Many hygroscopic plastics PC, ABS) absorb moisture from the air, which causes
bubbles or streaks in the final part. Dry them in a dehumidifying dryer at specific temperatures
(e.g., 80–120°C for ABS) for 2–4 hours. Colorants/Additives: Mix in pigments, fillers (glass fiber),
or stabilizers (UV resistance) as needed. Pre-com pounded materials (already colored) simplify this
step. 4. Injection Molding Machine Setup Injection molding machines consist of an injection unit
(melts plastic) and a clamping unit (holds and opens the mold). Setup steps: Mount the mold: Secure
the mold halves to the clamping unit (fixed and moving platens). Align carefully to avoid damage.
Set temperatures: Heat the barrel (injection unit) in zones to match the plastic’s melting point
(e.g., 180–230°C for PP, 230–300°C for ABS). The nozzle (connects to the mold) is also heated.
Clamping force: Adjust the clamping unit to apply enough force to keep the mold closed during
injection (prevents "flash"—plastic leaking between mold halves). Calculated based on part area and
material pressure. 5. The Injection Molding Cycle A single cycle produces one or more parts and
includes 4 main stages: a. Plasticizing (Melting) Granular plastic is fed into the barrel via a
hopper. A rotating screw pushes the plastic forward, heating it via friction and barrel heaters
until it melts into a viscous fluid (melt). The screw retracts slightly to accumulate a measured
volume of melt (shot size) at the front of the barrel. b. Injection The screw moves forward rapidly,
forcing the molten plastic through the nozzle and into the mold’s gating system, filling the cavity.
Key parameters: Injection pressure: Ensures the mold fills completely (varies by material; e.g.,
700–1500 bar). Injection speed: Controls how fast the cavity fills (too slow = cold spots; too fast
= turbulence/air traps). c.Packing & Holding Once the cavity is full, the screw maintains pressure
(holding pressure) to "pack" additional plastic into the mold, compensating for shrinkage as the
plastic cools. Reduces sink marks and ensures dimensional accuracy. d. Cooling The mold’s cooling
system circulates water to remove heat, solidifying the plastic. e. Ejection After cooling, the
clamping unit opens the mold. Ejection pins push the solidified part out of the cavity. The cycle
repeats (typically 10–60seconds, depending on part size, structure,weight, performance and so on).

##### Plastic raw material

There are many types of plastics and many raw materials possible. The vast majority come from
petroleum/crude oil ultimately. Many are made from crude oil and NGLs -natural Gas Liquids and other
hydrocarbons.Other materials such as chlorine to make PVC, are obtained from electrolysis of
seawater. Cellulosic polymers are made wood and plant materials. Quite a few rubbers are tapped from
the rubber tree

##### Prompt delivery

Plastics can meet virtually any polyethylene packaging need with our extensive selection of products
and sizes and broad range of specialty items, custom packaging and printing options. Our expert
staff personally analyzes your requirements and can provide a customized solution with our wide
range of of caps and bottles packaging.

##### Modern technology

Modern technology in Pakistan is a growing and rising industry that has a large potential. A matter
relating to the plastic The IT industry is regarded as a successful sector of Pakistan economically,
even in financial crisis. The World Economic Forum, assessing the development of modern and
Communication Technology in the country ranked Pakistan.

##### Standard packaging

Plastics standards are instrumental in specifying, testing, and assessing the physical, mechanical,
and chemical properties of a wide variety of materials and products that are made of plastic and its
polymeric derivatives. During processing, these synthetic or semisynthetic organic solids have a
very malleable characteristic that allows them to be molded into an assortment of shapes, making
them very suitable for the manufacture.

##### Availibility of perfect modulings

The products manufactured are packed in most attractive boxes and cartons of high quality, which
ensures safety, beauty and easy storability. Noor Enterprises offers Plastic Mouldings. We know that
detail can make the difference between looking good and looking perfect. As we are perfectionists,
we trade only in the best quality products.

##### Perfect costing

In the automotive industry and many other technology sectors in addition to innovation and quality
product costs are decisive in determining how successful a company will be with its products in
today’s competitive global market – and in the future. Along the entire value chain, reliable
costing processes, detailed knowledge of costs and maximum cost transparency are indispensable in
achieving excellent cost management for products and tools.

##### Plastic raw material

There are many types of plastics and many raw materials possible. The vast majority come from
petroleum/crude oil ultimately. Many are made from crude oil and NGLs -natural Gas Liquids and other
hydrocarbons.Other materials such as chlorine to make PVC, are obtained from electrolysis of
seawater. Cellulosic polymers are made wood and plant materials. Quite a few rubbers are tapped from
the rubber tree

##### Prompt delivery

Plastics can meet virtually any polyethylene packaging need with our extensive selection of products
and sizes and broad range of specialty items, custom packaging and printing options. Our expert
staff personally analyzes your requirements and can provide a customized solution with our wide
range of of caps and bottles packaging.

##### Modern technology

Modern technology in Pakistan is a growing and rising industry that has a large potential. A matter
relating to the plastic The IT industry is regarded as a successful sector of Pakistan economically,
even in financial crisis. The World Economic Forum, assessing the development of modern and
Communication Technology in the country ranked Pakistan.

##### Standard packaging

Plastics standards are instrumental in specifying, testing, and assessing the physical, mechanical,
and chemical properties of a wide variety of materials and products that are made of plastic and its
polymeric derivatives. During processing, these synthetic or semisynthetic organic solids have a
very malleable characteristic that allows them to be molded into an assortment of shapes, making
them very suitable for the manufacture.

##### Availibility of perfect modulings

The products manufactured are packed in most attractive boxes and cartons of high quality, which
ensures safety, beauty and easy storability. Noor Enterprises offers Plastic Mouldings. We know that
detail can make the difference between looking good and looking perfect. As we are perfectionists,
we trade only in the best quality products.

##### Perfect costing

In the automotive industry and many other technology sectors in addition to innovation and quality
product costs are decisive in determining how successful a company will be with its products in
today’s competitive global market – and in the future. Along the entire value chain, reliable
costing processes, detailed knowledge of costs and maximum cost transparency are indispensable in
achieving excellent cost management for products and tools.

## STEEL SALES FOR THE MELBOURNE AREA

If you need steel products, come and visit Northern Steel Sales in Melbourne’s Northern Suburbs.
We’ve been helping people cut and shape a variety of steel products since 1995. Have questions about
the services we provide? Give us a call and we’ll happily discuss your next project with you.

No matter what you need done with steel, we’re the experts that can make it happen. We offer
same-day delivery and prompt cut-to-size service. Come browse our huge selection of steel products
for all your projects. We help owner builders, steel fabricators, heavy engineering manufacturers,
and handymen of all kinds.

big and small projects. Give us a call today or visit our store in Melbourne’s Northern Suburbs.

## Sustainability

We believe in sustainability, so much that it is part of our company mission and vision. Our
sustainability initiatives can be found throughout our facilities from electricity savings to water
recycling. Our most impactful program is our EcoStar® post-consumer recycled material, that is made
of 75% or more recycled content.

[
Learn More
][29]

## Innovation

Our award winning team brings design elements to each project that utilize unique tool designs,
intricate trim features and achieve elegant functionality from simple open and closing, to
tamper-evident mechanisms. The experience our design team can bring to each project truly sets us
apart as we look to create, design and innovate packaging to protect and enhance your product on
shelf.

[
Learn More
][30]

## Collaboration

We listen to understand your product and work together to create an award winning design that
highlights your product. Our team will work with you every step of the way to exceed your
expectations from ideation to production. We make sure you, the customer is satisfied.

Learn More

# World Class Supplier of Your Tooling & Plastic Needs

The Plastek Group is a [trusted global supplier][84] of premium quality injection molding tools and
rigid plastic-molded packaging. As an innovative plastics processor, we can provide a [wide range of
targeted solutions][85] that meet your company’s unique challenges. Our 70 years of experience
enable us to serve businesses across a broad spectrum of industries.

[ Request a Quote ][86]
Plastek Locations

# Six Manufacturing Sites Worldwide

The Plastek Group has an international presence with six locations across four countries and three
continents to bring custom plastic manufacturing solutions to where you need them. We have locations
in the US, UK, Mexico and Brazil. Learn more about the unique capabilities at each of our sites.

[ Our Locations ][87]
Join a World-Class Team

# A Career For Tomorrow

That’s what you’ll find when you join the team at Plastek.
[Building careers][88] in the tooling and plastics industry since 1956.
Mold your future with job descriptions matching a wide variety of skill sets.
Advanced Technical positions on our tooling & manufacturing floors, and offices.
Now hiring skilled mold making and manufacturing workers on all shifts.
CNC Specialists, Process Technicians, Automation Technicians, Mold Set Up, and More.
Ask about Plastek’s on the job training, sign on bonus qualifications, and career development.
[Apply for tomorrow’s career][89], today!

OUR CAPABILITIES & OFFERINGS

## Plastic Manufacturing Capabilities and Fast-Moving Consumer Goods

As full-service plastic packaging suppliers, we can be your [one-stop shop for premium-quality
solutions][98]. Our capabilities include:
* **Package Development:** Our unwavering focus on [research and development][99] makes us an
  innovative plastic design corporation that continually invents the most advanced products.
* **Mold Design/Manufacturing:** Our capable [in-house engineering team][100] will collaborate with
  your company to develop and implement state-of-the-art plastic molded packaging concepts and other
  solutions to give you a competitive edge.
* **Molding/Assembly:** Our [injection molded packaging capabilities][101] include cutting-edge hot
  runner technology that reduces material waste and shortens cycle times. We also have
  high-performing blow molding presses ideally suited for various medical and pharmaceutical
  applications.

You’ll also find numerous stock packages that serve a wide range of packaging applications. Choose
from an assortment of jar caps, straight and round base jars, and oval, round, and gel soft/solid
propel/repel sticks.

Our Services

## Global Markets We Serve

Since the *[origin of our company in 1956][105]*, Plastek has become a worldwide mold-making and
plastics manufacturing leader. Our experience and unsurpassed industry knowledge enable us to meet
the requirements of these and other demanding and constantly evolving markets: *[Personal
Care][106]*, *[Health and Beauty][107]*, *[Home Care][108]*, *[Food and Beverage][109]*,
*[Pharmaceuticals/Nutraceuticals][110]*, Medical, Toy Manufacturing, Auto/Recreation, Aerospace,
Building and Construction, Battery Storage, Pet Care, and Home and Outdoors.

Personal Care Beauty Home Care Pharmaceutical Food & Beverage
Personal Care

We produce a large portion of the deodorant packaging sold around the world, as well as caps and
spouts for the laundry care industry.

[Learn More][111]
Beauty

We offer a variety of stock package options ideal for beauty creams, lotions and a variety of
additional general purpose products.

[Learn More][112]
Home Care

We manufacture caps and spouts for the laundry care industry. As a plastics processor, our
capabilities include injection molded rigid packaging options especially fit for safe consumer home
care products.

[Learn More][113]
Pharmaceutical

We produce various types of pharmaceutical assemblies and components to meet the needs of
laboratories, hospitals, physicians and over the counter applications.

[Learn More][114]
Food & Beverage

We provide containers and lids complete with lining, plus white room manufacturing. Plastek’s
certified class 7 clean room manufacturing guarantees environmentally controlled conditions and
production flexibility.

FOUNDED IN 1956

## Choose Plastek for All Your Plastic Manufacturing Needs

When you partner with us for plastics manufacturing and packaging, you get much more than
[high-quality products][122] and [services][123] that add value to your business. We also make
delivering exceptional customer service a top priority.

We will assign you a dedicated account manager, a customer service representative, and a quality
engineer who can answer your questions and address your concerns. When it’s time for an additional
project, you’ll work closely with a project manager who will guide you throughout the process. We’re
committed to delivering the attention and focus your company demands and deserves.

[ Learn More About Us ][124]
The Plastek Group Locations

## Global Location
## Manufacturing Sites

Our strategically located plastics factories have enabled us to establish a wide-reaching footprint
in various parts of the world.
* **United States:** Our headquarters site in Erie, PA, allows us to target the manufacturing needs
  of businesses on the East Coast and beyond.
* **United Kingdom:** We operate a plant in Mansfield, England, to provide prompt, efficient service
  to businesses throughout the UK and the European Union.
* **Brazil:** Our Indaiatuba location serves the largest country in South America.
* **Mexico:** We’ve formed enduring partnerships with numerous Mexican companies through our
  Queretaro facility.

# World Class Supplier of Your Tooling & Plastic Needs

The Plastek Group is a [trusted global supplier][84] of premium quality injection molding tools and
rigid plastic-molded packaging. As an innovative plastics processor, we can provide a [wide range of
targeted solutions][85] that meet your company’s unique challenges. Our 70 years of experience
enable us to serve businesses across a broad spectrum of industries.

[ Request a Quote ][86]
Plastek Locations

# Six Manufacturing Sites Worldwide

The Plastek Group has an international presence with six locations across four countries and three
continents to bring custom plastic manufacturing solutions to where you need them. We have locations
in the US, UK, Mexico and Brazil. Learn more about the unique capabilities at each of our sites.

[ Our Locations ][87]
Join a World-Class Team

# A Career For Tomorrow

That’s what you’ll find when you join the team at Plastek.
[Building careers][88] in the tooling and plastics industry since 1956.

# Meet The Group

Join us at these [upcoming events][91], and save the dates to meet The Plastek Group during a
variety of networking opportunities. The events we participate in provide a platform for new
business development, fostering connections between industry colleagues, suppliers, vendors, and
customers. Beyond business, we’re dedicated to building awareness within our community, engaging
students, and empowering the workforce. Don’t miss out on these enriching experiences that bring
growth and collaboration to the forefront.

OUR CAPABILITIES & OFFERINGS

## Plastic Manufacturing Capabilities and Fast-Moving Consumer Goods

As full-service plastic packaging suppliers, we can be your [one-stop shop for premium-quality
solutions][98]. Our capabilities include:
* **Package Development:** Our unwavering focus on [research and development][99] makes us an
  innovative plastic design corporation that continually invents the most advanced products.
* **Mold Design/Manufacturing:** Our capable [in-house engineering team][100] will collaborate with
  your company to develop and implement state-of-the-art plastic molded packaging concepts and other
  solutions to give you a competitive edge.
* **Molding/Assembly:** Our [injection molded packaging capabilities][101] include cutting-edge hot
  runner technology that reduces material waste and shortens cycle times. We also have
  high-performing blow molding presses ideally suited for various medical and pharmaceutical
  applications.

You’ll also find numerous stock packages that serve a wide range of packaging applications. Choose
from an assortment of jar caps, straight and round base jars, and oval, round, and gel soft/solid
propel/repel sticks.

When you partner with us for plastics manufacturing and packaging, you get much more than

committed to delivering the attention and focus your company demands and deserves.

**Plastiblends: Pioneering 'Colourful Possibilities' in the Plastics Industry**

Since 1991, Plastiblends has been at the forefront of the plastics industry in India, proudly
holding the title of the country's leading producer and exporter of colour, white, black, additive
and filler masterbatches. Our innovative products help to continuously shape advancements in
plastics and textile industries.

Headquartered in Mumbai, with key product development and application units in Daman, Roorkee and
Palsana, our extensive manufacturing infrastructure supports an impressive annual production
capacity of over 1,30,000 MT.

Our commitment to quality and innovation has earned us global recognition. We proudly export to over
60 countries, reflecting our brand’s reputation for trust and cutting-edge solutions.

At Plastiblends, our mission is clear: to explore and implement creative, innovative approaches to
meet and exceed the evolving needs of the plastics industry.

**Plastiblends: Pioneering 'Colourful Possibilities' in the Plastics Industry**

Since 1991, Plastiblends has been at the forefront of the plastics industry in India, proudly
holding the title of the country's leading producer and exporter of colour, white, black, additive
and filler masterbatches. Our innovative products help to continuously shape advancements in
plastics and textile industries.

Headquartered in Mumbai, with key product development and application units in Daman, Roorkee and
Palsana, our extensive manufacturing infrastructure supports an impressive annual production
capacity of over 1,30,000 MT.

Our commitment to quality and innovation has earned us global recognition. We proudly export to over
60 countries, reflecting our brand’s reputation for trust and cutting-edge solutions.

At Plastiblends, our mission is clear: to explore and implement creative, innovative approaches to
meet and exceed the evolving needs of the plastics industry.
