# We Package Solutions®

PTI is a global leader in sustainable rigid, flexible, thermoform packaging design, development, and
process technologies from concept to commercialization.
[ Learn More Learn More ][61]
Slide 1
Slide 2
Slide 3

## End-to-End Packaging Solutions

PTI is the only plastics packaging partner global brands rely on for fully integrated, lab-to-market
services. We’re constantly reimagining smart packaging and waste-reduction strategies, simulating
packaging performance and prototyping plastics that elevate consumer experience.

Our multidisciplinary team includes material scientists, engineering experts, sustainability
specialists and product support staff. Together, we collaboratively guide plastics projects from
conception and testing to design and delivery. And we’re intently focused on reducing cost,
squeezing out inefficiencies, reducing waste and accelerating speed to market.

[ Learn More Learn More ][62]

## Celebrating 40 Years of Success

PTI, a global leader in packaging innovation and material science, is celebrating its 40th
anniversary this year. Founded in 1985 in Toledo, Ohio, PTI has  grown from a regional packaging
engineering firm into a trusted partner for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Over the
past four decades, PTI has helped lead the evolution of packaging with a strong focus on sustainable
materials, medical packaging, barrier technologies and functional design.

Find out more about this important milestone by watching the highlight video.

[ Learn More Learn More ][63]
THE PTI PROCESS

## Our Process

Whether you're launching a new product, refreshing a legacy brand, or tackling sustainability goals,
our team of packaging experts will guide you through any and every step of the process with full
support and validation from an idea sketched on a piece of paper all the way to the store shelves.

We become an extension of your project team, dramatically decreasing iteration processes while
reducing costs and accelerating speed to market. PTI services include consumer experience design,
sharing knowledge of smart packaging, simulate packaging performances, prototyping packages, and
testing.

performance testing labs in the United States and Switzerland, and our team is a dedicated research
and development partner that informs packaging requirements, along with setting data-driven

up to demands, from production to user experience. We’re the preferred global lab for

# We Package Solutions®

PTI is a global leader in sustainable rigid, flexible, thermoform packaging design, development, and
process technologies from concept to commercialization.
[ Learn More Learn More ][61]

## End-to-End Packaging Solutions

PTI is the only plastics packaging partner global brands rely on for fully integrated, lab-to-market
services. We’re constantly reimagining smart packaging and waste-reduction strategies, simulating
packaging performance and prototyping plastics that elevate consumer experience.

Our multidisciplinary team includes material scientists, engineering experts, sustainability
specialists and product support staff. Together, we collaboratively guide plastics projects from
conception and testing to design and delivery. And we’re intently focused on reducing cost,
squeezing out inefficiencies, reducing waste and accelerating speed to market.

[ Learn More Learn More ][62]

## Celebrating 40 Years of Success

PTI, a global leader in packaging innovation and material science, is celebrating its 40th
anniversary this year. Founded in 1985 in Toledo, Ohio, PTI has  grown from a regional packaging
engineering firm into a trusted partner for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Over the
past four decades, PTI has helped lead the evolution of packaging with a strong focus on sustainable
materials, medical packaging, barrier technologies and functional design.

Find out more about this important milestone by watching the highlight video.

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

### Renewable Carbon Publications

nova-Institute is not only part of many research projects putting out valuable information on
bio-based and CO2-based chemicals, building blocks, polymers and materials as well as chemical
recycling topics, we also publish additional reports and background papers on policy, markets &
trends as well as technologies around the renewable circular economy.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/publications**][46]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Graphics]

### Renewable Carbon Graphics

We firmly believe in making knowledge accessible: not only do we offer free reports to spread
knowledge on renewable carbon-related topics, but we also supplement the written word with
attractive graphics.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/graphics**][47]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu News]

### Renewable Carbon News

Relevant press releases, interviews and general news keep you informed about the latest innovations,
inventions, investments and developments in bioeconomy, industrial biotechnology, bio-based
chemistry and materials, CO2-based materials, Carbon Capture & Utilisation (CCU) and Power-to-X
industries as well as chemical recycling. Keep up easily with the latest research and market
developments by subscribing to the daily newsletter, Twitter account or RSS feed.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/news**][48]

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Publications]

### Renewable Carbon Publications

nova-Institute is not only part of many research projects putting out valuable information on
bio-based and CO2-based chemicals, building blocks, polymers and materials as well as chemical
recycling topics, we also publish additional reports and background papers on policy, markets &
trends as well as technologies around the renewable circular economy.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/publications**][46]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Graphics]

### Renewable Carbon Graphics

We firmly believe in making knowledge accessible: not only do we offer free reports to spread
knowledge on renewable carbon-related topics, but we also supplement the written word with
attractive graphics.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/graphics**][47]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu News]

### Renewable Carbon News

Relevant press releases, interviews and general news keep you informed about the latest innovations,
inventions, investments and developments in bioeconomy, industrial biotechnology, bio-based
chemistry and materials, CO2-based materials, Carbon Capture & Utilisation (CCU) and Power-to-X
industries as well as chemical recycling. Keep up easily with the latest research and market
developments by subscribing to the daily newsletter, Twitter account or RSS feed.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/news**][48]

The bread and butter of our operation: top web design. Whether you’re starting from scratch, or

Zenith Eclipse plays a pivotal role in the agricultural and energy sectors. With a strong presence
in over 40 countries, we manage the entire value chain from cultivation and production to global
distribution, international trade, and logistics. Our commitment to excellence ensures seamless
operations, connecting high-quality products with markets worldwide.

helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and

worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared

We are committed to excellence in every delivery.

Our expansive global network ensures precise and efficient logistics services, connecting businesses
to markets seamlessly. Each hub is equipped to provide tailored logistics solutions, customized to
meet the unique demands of various industries. To discover how we can adapt our services to your
specific needs, reach out to our team of experts, who will guide you through our versatile logistics

and reliable service remains unwavering, helping you succeed in the ever-evolving global
marketplace.

### [What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?

Our mission is to transform lives, industries, and communities through unparalleled solutions in
global agribusiness, energy, and logistics. By placing safety, sustainability, and well-being at the
heart of every endeavor, we strive to build a future where innovation and responsibility flourish
side by side.

### [What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?

We envision a thriving, interconnected world where breakthroughs in agriculture, petrochemicals, and
logistics drive prosperity for all. At Zenith Eclipse Co, we continuously push boundaries and
redefine global standards, connecting people and businesses in a shared quest for a more sustainable
and progressive tomorrow.

### [How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?] How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?

Zenith Eclipse Co is not just a company—it’s a movement. Operating in over 40 countries, we bridge
the gap between top-quality products and the most demanding international markets. Our commitment to
excellence underpins a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, fueling our vision of a globally
unified community that transcends conventional business norms.

### [Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?] Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?

We support a diverse spectrum of industries, spanning agribusiness, renewable energy,
petrochemicals, logistics, and beyond. Our expertise allows us to integrate cutting-edge solutions
into complex supply chains and emerging markets, ensuring every partner benefits from our depth of
knowledge and global reach.

### [What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach to sustainability?] What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach
### to sustainability?

Sustainability is woven into our DNA. From responsible resource use to eco-friendly innovations in
transport and product development, every stage of our operation aims to reduce environmental impact
and uplift local communities. We believe that true progress requires safeguarding the planet for
generations to come.

### [How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?] How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?

We welcome collaborations with individuals, organizations, and governments who share our passion for
delivering value, promoting sustainable growth, and elevating global standards. Whether you’re
seeking premium agribusiness products, advanced logistics solutions, or forward-thinking energy
strategies, our dedicated experts will help tailor a partnership that aligns with your ambitions—and
helps realize them on a global stage.

Key Operations
Zenith Eclipse specializes in cultivating, processing, and distributing high-quality grains,

### Commitment and Responsibility

We’re committed to providing seeds you can count on—quality, reliable supply, and a responsible
approach from sourcing to delivery. We work to meet your needs and expectations while supporting
long-term, sustainable growth across the agricultural sector.

### Quality You Can Trust

From selection to final shipment, we keep a close eye on quality standards at every step. This focus
helps ensure consistent performance, customer satisfaction, and products that support strong results
season after season.

### Strong Distribution and On-Time Delivery

Our distribution network for grains and seeds is built to keep premium products accessible across a
wide range of agricultural markets. With efficient supply chain management, we make sure deliveries
arrive on time while maintaining the same high standards every time.

### Sustainable Agriculture

Sustainability is central to how we work. We support farming practices that strengthen integrity,
improve resource efficiency, and help farmers remain profitable—while also protecting soil health
and biodiversity for the future.

### Seed Processing with Purpose

After oil extraction, we turn the remaining seed meal into a valuable, nutrient-rich resource for
both livestock and plants. This approach supports healthier animal feed and helps ensure nothing
goes to waste—using the same strict quality standards applied to our seeds.

### Harvest Season and Global Reach

Harvest season is where a full year of work comes together. Our team carefully harvests, processes,
and stores seeds to protect quality, viability, and consistency. Backed by a global supply network,
we source from multiple regions and manage shipping efficiently so customers receive high-quality
products wherever they are.

## Innovation in Action

We champion a culture of innovation across our agriculture, energy, petrochemicals, and logistics
divisions. From precision farming and clean energy solutions to advanced petrochemical processes and
driven logistics, our teams constantly explore new ideas to drive efficiency and sustainability in
every sector. By turning fresh ideas into real‑world applications, we stay ahead of industry
challenges and deliver greater value to our customers and partners.

## Global Reach, Local Impact

Operating in over many countries, our influence is truly global—we help feed populations and fuel
industries by delivering essential commodities where they’re needed most. At the same time, we
believe in giving back: we work hand‑in‑hand with farming communities, support education and

worldwide impact with local commitment, Zenith Eclipse Co turns global success into shared
prosperity for communities and customers alike.

## Collaborate with Us

Partnering with us means choosing a path to success. We offer competitive pricing, exceptional
customer service, and a commitment to excellence in everything we do. Our wide selection of seeds,
including flaxseeds, rapeseeds, mustard seeds, and coriander seeds, is designed to help you meet
your business goals. Together, we can cultivate a more sustainable and flavorful future for all.
We are committed to excellence in every delivery.

Our expansive global network ensures precise and efficient logistics services, connecting businesses
to markets seamlessly. Each hub is equipped to provide tailored logistics solutions, customized to
meet the unique demands of various industries. To discover how we can adapt our services to your
specific needs, reach out to our team of experts, who will guide you through our versatile logistics
capabilities. Whether you're a startup or a multinational corporation, our dedication to consistent
and reliable service remains unwavering, helping you succeed in the ever-evolving global
marketplace.

### [What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the mission of Zenith Eclipse Co?

Our mission is to transform lives, industries, and communities through unparalleled solutions in
global agribusiness, energy, and logistics. By placing safety, sustainability, and well-being at the
heart of every endeavor, we strive to build a future where innovation and responsibility flourish
side by side.

### [What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?] What is the vision of Zenith Eclipse Co?

We envision a thriving, interconnected world where breakthroughs in agriculture, petrochemicals, and
logistics drive prosperity for all. At Zenith Eclipse Co, we continuously push boundaries and
redefine global standards, connecting people and businesses in a shared quest for a more sustainable
and progressive tomorrow.

### [How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?] How does Zenith Eclipse Co differ from others?

Zenith Eclipse Co is not just a company—it’s a movement. Operating in over 40 countries, we bridge
the gap between top-quality products and the most demanding international markets. Our commitment to
excellence underpins a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, fueling our vision of a globally
unified community that transcends conventional business norms.

### [Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?] Which industries does Zenith Eclipse Co serve?

We support a diverse spectrum of industries, spanning agribusiness, renewable energy,
petrochemicals, logistics, and beyond. Our expertise allows us to integrate cutting-edge solutions
into complex supply chains and emerging markets, ensuring every partner benefits from our depth of
knowledge and global reach.

### [What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach to sustainability?] What is Zenith Eclipse Co’s approach
### to sustainability?

Sustainability is woven into our DNA. From responsible resource use to eco-friendly innovations in
transport and product development, every stage of our operation aims to reduce environmental impact
and uplift local communities. We believe that true progress requires safeguarding the planet for
generations to come.

### [How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?] How can I partner with Zenith Eclipse Co?

We welcome collaborations with individuals, organizations, and governments who share our passion for
delivering value, promoting sustainable growth, and elevating global standards. Whether you’re
seeking premium agribusiness products, advanced logistics solutions, or forward-thinking energy
strategies, our dedicated experts will help tailor a partnership that aligns with your ambitions—and
helps realize them on a global stage.
